user_story: As a user, I want to see an error when I try to log in with a wrong password so that I know my credentials are incorrect.

positive.title: Successful display of error message on wrong password
steps: Enter a valid username and an incorrect password.
positive.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the credentials are incorrect.

negative.title: No error message when credentials are correct
steps: Enter a valid username and the correct password.
negative.expected_result: No error message is displayed; the user is successfully logged in.

edge.title: Error message on blank password
steps: Enter a valid username and leave the password field blank.
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the password field cannot be left blank.
